newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell sharply to 577 million yuan from 1.934 billion yuan with the one-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was dull as state banks and non-banking financial institutions cut their volume in the lead-up to the weekend, traders said.
"Some financial institutions that need short-term funds borrowed heavily on Wednesday and Thursday, so they were reluctant to trade today," said one trader.

Falling inflation in recent months had had a negative impact on the interbank rates, making financial institutions unwilling to build long-term positions and thus contributing to the low turnover, traders said.
Traders said they expected volume to recover early next week with the interbank rates moving narrrowly.
